{
  "name": "cost-visibility",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Live cost, context, and plan-quota meters above the Claude Code prompt (Nerd Font required for icons). Type /spend for the detail pane. Optional cost guards via /spend caps on.",
  "author": {
    "name": "patitow",
    "url": "https://github.com/patitow"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/patitow/claude-mod-cost-visibility",
  "repository": "https://github.com/patitow/claude-mod-cost-visibility",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-mod",
    "mod",
    "cost",
    "usage",
    "quota",
    "context",
    "spend",
    "visibility",
    "nerd-font"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "costGuards": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Cost guards",
      "description": "When on, block /code-review max|xhigh|ultra|braba, background agents, and multi-angle review fan-out. Off by default (HUD only). Toggle with /spend caps on|off or /config.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
